events.summary: Teyo Verada is buried alive after a diamondstorm and is whisked away to Ravnica when he becomes a planeswalker.
Bolas lures planeswalkers to Ravnica and lays siege to the city seeking godhood.
events.quote: Bolas lays siege to the city of Ravnica, hungry for the ultimate prize: godhood itself.

events.summary: The Gatewatch works to unite the mages and defend the city, discovering Bolas has prepared a trap for the most powerful mages.
